body:
Source: repo-bloat review (rev-tests finding 1 & 2, issue #1043). Nine test files in plugins/adlc-claude-code, plugins/adlc-opencode, and plugins/adlc-herdr manually invoke mkdtempSync and guard removals in try/finally blocks, and are allowlisted in scripts/test/tmp-fixture-boundary.test.mjs. With @adlc/core/test-kit (tmp), fixture directories automatically register cleanup via t.after when passed the test context t.

NORMATIVE BEHAVIOUR.
1. In plugins/adlc-claude-code/hooks/test/:
   - In handoff-continuation-start.test.mjs, handoff-resolve-global.test.mjs, handoff-secret-scrub.test.mjs, manifest.test.mjs, wrapper-entry-point.test.mjs:
     * Import { tmp } from '@adlc/core/test-kit'.
     * Update test declarations to accept t parameter from test(...).
     * Replace mkdtempSync calls with tmp(t, prefix).
     * Remove manual try { ... } finally { rmSync(dir, ...); } blocks, unindenting test bodies.
2. In plugins/adlc-opencode/test/:
   - In handoff-deny.test.mjs, scaffold.test.mjs, session-hooks.test.mjs:
     * Import { tmp } from '@adlc/core/test-kit'.
     * Update test declarations to accept t parameter.
     * Replace mkdtempSync calls with tmp(t, prefix).
     * Remove manual try/finally blocks, unindenting test bodies.
3. In plugins/adlc-herdr/test/fleet-bridge.test.mjs:
   - Import { tmp } from '@adlc/core/test-kit'.
   - Update test declarations to accept t parameter.
   - Replace mkdtempSync with tmp(t, 'herdr-fleet-').
   - Remove manual try/finally blocks, unindenting test bodies.
4. In scripts/test/tmp-fixture-boundary.test.mjs:
   - Remove all 5 plugins/adlc-claude-code entries, all 3 plugins/adlc-opencode entries, and the plugins/adlc-herdr entry from the ALLOWLIST set (completely eradicating all three plugins from the allowlist!).
5. Verification:
   - node scripts/run-tests.mjs claude-code exits 0 with all tests passing.
   - node scripts/run-tests.mjs opencode exits 0 with all tests passing.
   - node scripts/run-tests.mjs herdr exits 0 with all tests passing.
   - node --test scripts/test/tmp-fixture-boundary.test.mjs exits 0.
   - grep -E 'plugins/(adlc-claude-code|adlc-opencode|adlc-herdr)/' scripts/test/tmp-fixture-boundary.test.mjs returns nothing.

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA.
- AC1 All 9 test files contain 0 finally blocks.
- AC2 mkdtempSync is not called in any of the 9 test files.
- AC3 grep -E 'plugins/(adlc-claude-code|adlc-opencode|adlc-herdr)/' scripts/test/tmp-fixture-boundary.test.mjs returns nothing.
- AC4 node scripts/run-tests.mjs claude-code exits 0.
- AC5 node scripts/run-tests.mjs opencode exits 0.
- AC6 node scripts/run-tests.mjs herdr exits 0.
- AC7 node --test scripts/test/tmp-fixture-boundary.test.mjs exits 0.
- AC8 adlc rails-guard exits 0.
title: refactor(adlc-claude-code,adlc-opencode,adlc-herdr): adopt @adlc/core/test-kit and eliminate try/finally blocks in Claude-Code, OpenCode, and Herdr tests
